goal: answer.txt contains the total of the amount column in sales.csv, as digits only.
task:
The file sales.csv in your current working directory holds one sales record per row. Add up every value in the `amount` column and write the total to a file named answer.txt.

Write the total as digits only — no currency symbol, no thousands separators, no explanatory text. For example, a total of one thousand two hundred would be written as 1200.
